expectations.text: Report contains a SUMMARY section with numerical counts by category
expectations.evidence: Lines 13-22 contain a '## SUMMARY' section with counts: notes: 12, implementation ideas: 4, tensions: 5, enrichment tasks: 6, validations: 2, open questions: 3, skipped: 2, TOTAL OUTPUTS: 32.

expectations.text: Total extractions (claims + implementation ideas + tensions + enrichments + validations) >= 8
expectations.evidence: 12 claims + 4 implementation ideas + 5 tensions + 6 enrichments + 2 validations = 29 extraction items (32 total outputs including open questions and skipped). Well above the threshold of 8.

expectations.text: Skip rate is below 15% (skipped items / total candidates)
expectations.evidence: Explicitly stated in calibration check: 'Skip rate: 2/34 candidates = 5.9% (well below 10% threshold for domain-relevant sources)'. Two items skipped: VocalMat tool description (already captured elsewhere) and bibliographic metadata.

expectations.text: Every extracted item includes a rationale explaining why it was extracted
expectations.evidence: All 12 claims have a 'Rationale:' field explaining extraction reasoning. All 4 implementation ideas have 'Why it matters:' fields. All 5 tensions have 'Why it matters:' fields. All 6 enrichment tasks have 'Why:' fields. All 2 validations have 'Why this matters:' fields. All 3 open questions have 'Rationale:' fields. Even the 2 skipped items have 'Reason:' fields.

expectations.text: Extracted titles are phrased as claims/propositions, not topic labels
expectations.evidence: Representative titles checked: (1) 'VocalMat adaptive thresholding eliminates fixed detection thresholds by adapting to local noise floor' -- proposition about what adaptive thresholding does. (2) 'VocalMat achieves over 99.7 percent detection sensitivity with 4428 of 4441 USVs detected' -- quantitative claim. (3) 'differential geometry features extract USV shape information independent of absolute frequency or duration' -- proposition about feature properties. All are complete claims, not topic labels.

expectations.text: At least 3 distinct categories are represented (e.g. core claims, implementation ideas, tensions)
expectations.evidence: Six distinct categories: CLAIMS (12 items), IMPLEMENTATION IDEAS (4 items), TENSIONS (5 items), ENRICHMENT TASKS (6 items), VALIDATIONS (2 items), OPEN QUESTIONS (3 items). All are represented with dedicated sections.

expectations.text: Report mentions checking existing notes for duplicates or overlap
expectations.evidence: PROCESS NOTES section (lines 288-290): 'Vector search unavailable (qmd embeddings not built). Duplicate detection fell back to keyword grep against notes/ directory. This is a Tier 3 fallback per the skill specification.' Also: 'Existing VocalMat coverage: The vault already has 2 VocalMat-specific notes and 11 additional notes referencing VocalMat.' Multiple claim rationales reference existing vault notes to demonstrate non-duplication.

expectations.text: The tension between discrete USV categories and continuous acoustic space is captured
expectations.evidence: Tension #2: 'Discrete 11-category classification versus continuous acoustic space for USVs' -- explicitly states 'VocalMat classifies into 11 discrete categories, but their own t-SNE/UMAP projections show significant overlap zones between categories. The classification system imposes boundaries on what appears to be a continuum.' Connects to Holy & Guo 2005, Goffinet 2021, and VQ-VAE approach.
